item.title: RobustNet
item.description: Implemented a ResNet from scratch using best-practice training techniques, then integrated conformal prediction at inference to output a prediction set rather than a single label—for more robust and trustworthy predictions.

item.title: Ego-Curation
item.description: Built a pipeline that curates egocentric video datasets (e.g., Ego4D) using V-JEPA 2 prediction error to surface the most surprising segments of each video.
